CustomField.description: How EmailService reads Value__c: Address (one email address), Queue (queue DeveloperName, its active members), PublicGroup (public group DeveloperName, its active members) or RecordField (field path on the email's record: a User, Queue or Group lookup gives its active users, an Email or Text field gives addresses; the first User in To becomes the email's recipient record, like the Flow's Recipient Id).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: What Value contains. Address: one email address. Queue / Public Group: its API name, its active members receive the email. Record Field: a field of the email's record (Record Id), e.g. OwnerId, AgentOwner__c or Contact__r.Email. A user in To receives it as the Flow's Recipient Id would.
CustomField.label: Type
